name: Montana 4-H Fall Leadership Training
what_you_do: Spend a weekend with other 4-H teen leaders and ambassadors. Go to workshops on Saturday. Hear an alumni speaker at a banquet. Join the statewide ambassador meeting.
who_can_apply: Montana 4-H youth who are at least 14 years old as of October 1 of the 4-H year. Counties send ambassadors and teen leaders. Chaperones must be certified 4-H volunteers or MSU Extension staff, age 21 or older.
pay_detail: $195. It covers lodging (2 to 4 people per room), Saturday and Sunday meals and program costs. Friday dinner is on your own.
deadline_text: Event is November 6 to 8, 2026 at the Copper King Hotel and Convention Center in Butte. State registration closes October 19, 2026.
how_to_apply: Register online in the 4-H Zsuite system. Call your county MSU Extension office for county rules. Fill in your info and waivers before the event.
notes: Cancel before sign-up closes for a full refund. Dress is business casual on Saturday. Dress for the banquet is business professional to semi-formal.
